label: unstated
reason: The docstring never says that a sentence boundary depends on the case of the following word, so the test's expected merge of "Aaa. bbbb" is not derivable from it.
missing: The docstring should state the boundary rule: a sentence-ending punctuation mark (. ? !) only ends a sentence when the next word begins with an uppercase letter, and otherwise the text stays joined, with the punctuation removed from every sentence except the last.
